prompt:
Generate an ORIGINAL academic textbook illustration. Design the composition yourself from scientific content, not from any existing textbook figure. The attached images are newly selected external OpenStax anatomy references ONLY for anatomical facts, not layout/style. Output ONLY UNLABELED PNG artwork on a genuinely transparent canvas. No letters, numbers, captions, formula marks, pseudo-text, watermarks, header/footer/title. Reserve useful clear blank areas adjacent to key anatomical components for later typesetting. Flat clean 2D biological diagram, fine outlines, readable mechanisms, generous whitespace. No 3D, shadow, gloss, texture, paper grain, waves, mottling, noise, stripe, gradients. Every colored region is a spatially constant SOLID fill. Main palette Blue #7B95C6, Cyan #49C2D9, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6, Rose #C85E62, dark ink #3B4252; use pale uniform tints with white. No decorative icon cards. Anatomy can have simple fine anatomical contour lines but no decorative shading.
CONTENT: complementary lateral brain anatomy and medial occipital inset, plus a compact abstract pathway schematic if useful, to explain dorsal and ventral visual streams. Provide an anatomically plausible lateral cerebral hemisphere outline, anterior left / occipital posterior right, with sparse sulci (central sulcus is a landmark, not a processing node). Visual cortex in posterior occipital region; dorsal stream moves toward superior parietal cortex; ventral stream moves along inferior temporal cortex toward anterior temporal cortex. Dorsal uses blue arrows; ventral uses muted rose arrows. Their origins are the early visual areas in posterior occipital cortex. Medial inset reveals calcarine sulcus and V1 around it; avoid pretending medial V1 is fully visible on lateral outer surface. Mark small simple pale homogeneous area patches for later labels V1, V2, V3, MT/V5, V4, inferior temporal cortex and parietal cortex, anatomically approximate and diagrammatic without sharp fake cytoarchitectonic maps. Compact mechanism schematic, if included, must be a branched structure: retina→LGN→V1/V2, then split upward toward motion/dorsal/parietal and downward toward V4/temporal/object route; not a single serial chain. Cross-talk/feedback are omitted for pedagogic simplification. Do not label anything; preserve open slots near patches and empty small schematic nodes. No duplicate unnecessary brain views. Wide landscape original composition.
reference_policy: No original/previous project images provided. External OpenStax references only.

selected.prompt: Edit reference1 ONLY by replacing the colors with the muted palette below and rounding ordinary module rectangles. Preserve the EXACT original canvas, component positions, margins, scale, all shapes, all grids and their row/column counts, node counts, every connector, arrow direction and line endpoints. Do NOT redesign or reflow anything. Reference2 is ONLY the palette/reference finish; never copy its topology. Current figure is neural-visual-pathways, original canvas 1536×1024px. Main representations, networks, states, ordinary outputs and computation blocks should be blue; green only auxiliary inputs/alternate branch, yellow only gates/selection/position, red only loss/errors/gradient correction, purple only a needed additional category. Distinct classes retain distinguishable muted colors. Natural photographic examples and anatomy colors retain their scientific meaning. Do not add text or symbols that were not in the reference. Style: exact white opaque canvas; flat 2D technical drawing, no gradients, textures, shadows, pseudo text, numbers or letters. Rounded rectangle modules (6 px corner radius), neutral dark wires #556170. Blue priority #7188A3 with fill #E5EAF0 for the main mechanism; muted green #829C8B fill #E8EEE9 only secondary sources; muted yellow #B4A16F fill #F1ECDD for position/selection; muted red #A7787D fill #F0E5E6 only losses/errors, not the generic output; purple #9588A5 only a further category if needed. Most area white, fills pale and uniform. Draw all shapes, actual mechanism glyphs, matrices and connectors, leave labels empty for real-font typography.
